title: 2024 HMMT November Guts Problem 4
statement: The number \(17^{6}\) when written out in base 10 contains 8 distinct digits from \(1,2, \ldots, 9\), with no repeated digits or zeroes. Compute the missing nonzero digit.

solutions.text:
Observe that

\[17^{6} \equiv(-1)^{6}=1 \bmod 9\]

If \(x\) is the missing digit, then the digits of \(17^{6}\) sum to \((1+2+\cdots+9)-x=45-x\), so \(45-x \equiv 1 \bmod 9\). We conclude \(x=8\).
